heroHeadline: PAHO formally strips US of measles elimination status; 5,412 cases in 2026
heroSubtitle: PAHO's director accepted the commission's recommendation on Nov 17, withdrawing elimination status from the US, Mexico and Bolivia. CDC counts 5,412 confirmed 2026 cases (+230 in the Nov 13 update), 96% outbreak-associated; CDC lists 6 deaths while states report 10.
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports, major outlets, and institutional analyses.
